# Batch profile asset provenance

The Welingkar logo and campus image were copied from the public recruiter
snapshot in tanmay7264/candidate360, gh-pages commit
e471a90751252815be91ee60800ccb15bc58617f.

`brand/recruiter-team.png` was generated using Higgsfield GPT Image 2.6,
job 84fa0a4e-5565-4398-9415-9bd0b483feac. It is conceptual imagery and
does not depict actual students.

The dashboard is now implemented directly in `src/batch-profile/` with Meta
Astryx. The prior compiled Next.js snapshot and runtime patching are removed.
Fictional demo values were transcribed into `src/batch-profile/data.js`; these
are not verified placement or student records.
